name: ai-coding-harness
description: Hard constraints for AI coding in auto mode: shell allowlist + sole write gateway + tamper-proof lock manifest + passphrase authorization (stdin + process tree verification + failure throttling) + plan/worklog traceability + dashboard. All constraints exist only in code gates; there are no prompt-based soft constraints.
author: harness-team
triggers: Keep AI from forgetting standards / strict enforcement
Security constraints for AI with shell access
Sole write channel for project files
capabilities: PreToolUse allowlist hard gate: shell lexical splitting (full coverage of pipes/&&/;/$/`<()`/redirection/heredoc), read-only commands automatically allowed, unknown commands generate an authorization ticket and are denied
Sole project-file write channel harness publish: path protection + deterministic key fingerprint + high-entropy key + syntax check + batch threshold + backup + manifest archiving
Tamper-proof lock manifest fail-closed: hash hook/CLI/pre-commit/hooks.json; when corrupted, reject all mutating operations (read-only operations are still allowed)

Passphrase authorization (does not rely on /dev/tty): read passphrase from stdin + sha256+salt stored with 0600 + process tree verification (reject agent process tree) + failure throttling (3 failures lock for 60 seconds)

Authorization ticket mechanism: unknown commands generate a pending ticket; the user runs harness confirm to approve (once/always/permanently allow the program/deny); one-time permits are burned after use
plan/worklog traceability: plan.md signature solidifies the baseline; each step is a git tag (harness-sN-*); harness log why <file> checks the reason for a change
Reconciliation gate: reconcile with git status before publish/approve/step done/commit; if unregistered stray changes exist, reject (harness adopt requires passphrase registration)
harness abort: after passphrase confirmation, git reset --hard rolls back to any checkpoint tag and cleans untracked new files
Real-time dashboard: only the standard library http.server is used, refresh every 3 seconds, visualize status/plan todos/steps/publications/authorization tickets/interceptions
SessionStart injects facts (current step/plan todos/recent steps/lock manifest status), does not inject behavioral norms; Stop hook final reconciliation block

changelog.changes: Documentation adds over-threshold and ABORTED terminal-state continuation specifications: (1) SKILL.md adds an 'Over-threshold and ABORTED terminal-state continuation' section: single-step ≤500 LOC; over-threshold must split steps/streamline, do not force through; ABORTED is terminal (state_machine.py has no outgoing edges); status summary IN_PROGRESS is only an unsynchronized snapshot, the underlying state is authoritative; continuation must use harness init --force to reset the plan and create a new task_id (without --force it will skip), retain completed code/tags/worklog, reference them in the new plan without redoing; the first step of the new task is git diff --stat to inventory residual changes and record the ABORTED reason; directly modifying state.json to revive the task is prohibited (.harness/ writes denied + tamper lock + validate rejects illegal transitions).

AI drafting area migrated from system /tmp to project root .harness-tmp/. (1) pre_tool_use.is_project_file changed to pure realpath determination: only paths resolving under root and not under .harness-tmp are protected; symlinks in scratch pointing to src/ resolve to src/ and are still rejected (anti-bypass); symlinks in src/ pointing to scratch only modify scratch content and are deemed harmless. (2) harness cmd_publish allows source files under .harness-tmp/, rejects other in-project sources (out-of-project sources are still compatibly allowed). (3) _resolve_dest rejects .harness-tmp as a publish destination. (4) is_ignored hardcodes ignoring .harness-tmp/ (on the upgrade path, old ignore files not containing this entry do not affect reconciliation). (5) install.sh unconditionally idempotently ensures .harness-tmp/ exists and .gitignore/.harnessignore contain this entry (fixes the gap where --upgrade does not refresh existing ignore files). (6) _redirect_ok accepts a root parameter, allowing redirection to .harness-tmp/. (7) lock_candidates does not include scratch (mutable). (8) Copy/documentation/install prompts unified to .harness-tmp/.

v3 rewritten as a hard-constraint framework for auto mode; the threat model changed to 'AI will cause damage'; all constraints exist only in code gates. (1) PreToolUse allowlist rewritten: shell lexical splitting covers pipes/&&/;/$(...)/backticks/<(...)/${...}/redirection/heredoc; command substitutions inside quotes are also extracted and classified; read-only command allowlist tightened (removed env/less/uniq/xxd/xargs/tee/sed/awk and other commands that can execute subprocesses or write files); git subcommand allowlist + prohibit arguments such as -c/--config-env/--output/--ext-diff that can execute external programs; find prohibits -exec/-delete etc.; sort prohibits -o/--compress-program; rg prohibits --pre; date prohibits -s; leading environment variables allow only a few such as LANG/LC_*/TZ/TERM; PATH/GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF etc. all require authorization. (2) Single CLI gateway harness: publish/approve/step/confirm/adopt/log/status/abort/dashboard/doctor/passwd; sole write channel for project files; review (key fingerprint + high entropy + syntax) + backup + manifest; reconcile before publish. (3) Passphrase authorization changed to stdin + process tree verification + failure throttling, not relying on /dev/tty (compatible with low-privilege servers without pts); the main defense line is the passphrase (AI does not know it and cannot read the 0600 secret file); process tree verification is auxiliary. (4) Tamper-proof lock manifest fail-closed: hash hook/CLI/pre-commit/hooks.json; corruption rejects changes (read-only allowed). (5) plan/worklog traceability: each step is a git tag, harness log why <file>, harness abort rollback. (6) Real-time dashboard (standard library only). End-to-end verified: install→publish→approve→step→publish→step done→log/why/status, key/syntax interception, lock tampering rejection, pre-commit reconciliation interception, adopt/abort/upgrade, confirm one-time permit consumption, passphrase failure throttling.
